text:
Marta G: Heads-up: vendor engagement (Asteria) next Wed. Focus: KMS decrypt flows and RBAC. Window 2025-08-13 09:00-15:00 UTC. Need final ACL and evidence export plan. @Sanjay R please propose minimal role, @Jess L confirm SIEM retention/immutability, @Ryan T outline triage & retest cadence.

Sanjay R: Suggest assessor role with only kms:Decrypt on specific key alias, deny Encrypt/GenerateDataKey/CreateKey. Use kms-proxy with required header x-pt-id and audit_fields [request_id,key_id,caller,x-pt-id]. Token TTL 6h, rotate every 60m.

Jess L: Will set SIEM index pt-asteria-20250813 to 90d retention and immutability for 14 days. Also schedule EOD export to secure bucket for chain-of-custody.

Marta G: Remediation rules: PR + test vector + ops smoke-run required before retest. Retest only after QA signoff.

Ryan T: Triage: ack within 8h; critical fix within 72h and block deploys if PoC exists; medium within 10 days. Retest slots will be 2h blocks in the week after fixes. OpsBot will issue ephemeral creds.

OpsBot: ephemeral role created assessor-asteria-20250813 ttl=6h issued_by=@Marta G. SIEM index pt-asteria-20250813 created.

Sanjay R: ACL snippet:
```
{
  "role":"assessor-asteria-20250813",
  "allow":["Decrypt"],
  "deny":["Encrypt","GenerateDataKey","CreateKey"],
  "require_header":"x-pt-id",
  "audit_fields":["request_id","key_id","caller","x-pt-id"],
  "rotate_token_minutes":60
}
```
I'll open a PR with the template and a test that asserts audit JSON contains request_id and key_id.

Jess L: Ticket created INF-SIEM-900 to set retention/export and add saved view for x-pt-id.

Marta G: Thanks. Action items: Sanjay PR; Jess SIEM ticket + export; Ryan publish triage cadence + calendar. Dry-run Fri 11:00 UTC to validate audit lines and export. :thumbsup:
